WITH lines AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        CAST(CAST(i.qty AS DECIMAL(18,0)) * CAST(i.unit_price AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS line_value
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'order_items') }} i
    JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'products') }} p
        ON p.product_id = i.product_id
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        LOWER(category) AS category_key,
        MIN(category) AS category,
        SUM(line_value) AS line_sum,
        COUNT(line_value) AS non_null_lines,
        COUNT(*) AS line_count
    FROM lines
    GROUP BY LOWER(category)
)
SELECT
    category,
    CAST(
        (CAST(line_sum * 1000000 AS HUGEINT) // non_null_lines)
        AS DECIMAL(38,6)
    ) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS avg_line_value,
    line_count
FROM agg

explanation: This procedure builds a summary table that shows, for each product category, the average value of an order line (quantity times unit price) and the number of order lines. It joins order items to products and groups by category. The model reproduces SQL Server's case-insensitive grouping and its truncated decimal averages.
